title: Scheme-theoretic support of a finite type quasi-coherent module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], with support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2). For an open $U\subseteq X$ let $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)=\{a\in\mathcal O_X(U): a|_V\,s=0\text{ for every open }V\subseteq U\text{ and every }s\in\mathcal F(V)\}$. Then: (1) $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$, and for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ one has $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}(\mathcal F(U))$. (2) There is a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$; for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $i^{-1}(U)\to U$ is isomorphic over $U$ to $\operatorname{Spec}(A/\operatorname{Ann}_A(\mathcal F(U)))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. (3) $i(Z)=\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$. (4) $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)\,\mathcal F=0$: $as=0$ for every open $V$, $a\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(V)$ and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$. (5) If $i':Z'\to X$ is a closed immersion whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal I'$ satisfies $\mathcal I'\mathcal F=0$, then $\mathcal I'\subseteq\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$. The closed subscheme $Z$ is the *scheme-theoretic support* of $\mathcal F$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 05JU (morphisms-lemma-scheme-theoretic-support) with its proof (affine-local description (1), support (4), the algebra fact Ann_A(M)_f = Ann_{A_f}(M_f) for finite M, which the proof omits and which is Algebra Lemma 07T8 algebra-lemma-annihilator-flat-base-change, and Lemma 01QQ morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion-bijection-ideals for the closed subscheme cut out by a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf), and Definition 05JV (morphisms-definition-scheme-theoretic-support)

proof.text: *Step 1 ($\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ is a sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$).* For open $U$, $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)$ is an ideal of $\mathcal O_X(U)$: if $a,b$ lie in it and $c\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, then $(a+b)|_Vs=a|_Vs+b|_Vs=0$ and $(ca)|_Vs=c|_V(a|_Vs)=0$ for every open $V\subseteq U$ and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, since $\mathcal F(V)$ is an $\mathcal O_X(V)$-module and restriction is a ring map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. It is stable under restriction: for $W\subseteq U$ and $V\subseteq W$, $(a|_W)|_V=a|_V$. It is a sheaf, i.e. membership is local: let $a\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ and $U=\bigcup_jU_j$ an open covering with $a|_{U_j}\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U_j)$ for all $j$; for $V\subseteq U$ open and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, $(a|_Vs)|_{V\cap U_j}=a|_{V\cap U_j}\,s|_{V\cap U_j}=0$ for all $j$, so $a|_Vs=0$ by the sheaf property of $\mathcal F$, and $a\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)$. As $\mathcal O_X$ is a sheaf, the subpresheaf $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ with this locality is a subsheaf of ideals.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 05JU and its proof (the annihilator ideal sheaf is implicit there; this step writes out that the rule is a sheaf of ideals)

proof.text: *Step 2 (sections on affine opens: $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(W)=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_X(W)}(\mathcal F(W))$).* Let $W\subseteq X$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(W)$, $M=\mathcal F(W)$. The inclusion $\subseteq$ is the case $V=W$ of the definition. Conversely let $a\in\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)$, $V\subseteq W$ open and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$. Under $W\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] the principal opens $W_g$, $g\in A$, correspond to the $D(g)$ and form a basis of the topology of $W$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; so $V$ is covered by principal opens $W_g\subseteq V$. Each $W_g$ is an affine open with $\mathcal O_X(W)\to\mathcal O_X(W_g)$ a localization $A\to A_g$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-ideals-closed-subscheme](0), and since $\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent the map $M\otimes_AA_g\to\mathcal F(W_g)$, $m\otimes r\mapsto r\,m|_{W_g}$, is bijective [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-affine-section-base-change] (with $U'=W$, $U=W_g$). So every element of $\mathcal F(W_g)$ is $\sum_kr_k\,m_k|_{W_g}$, and $a|_{W_g}\sum_kr_km_k|_{W_g}=\sum_kr_k(am_k)|_{W_g}=0$ as $am_k=0$. In particular $a|_{W_g}\,s|_{W_g}=(a|_Vs)|_{W_g}=0$ for every $W_g\subseteq V$ in the covering, hence $a|_Vs=0$ by the sheaf property of $\mathcal F$. So $a\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(W)$. (No finiteness is used here.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 05JU (1) and its proof ('the characterization in (1)'): agent-written verification that the sheaf Ann(F) has the affine-local sections Ann_A(M) of (1)

proof.text: *Step 3 (compatibility with principal opens).* Let $W$, $A$, $M$ be as in Step 2 and $f\in A$. Since $\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent of finite type, $M$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine](c). By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-ideals-closed-subscheme](0) $W_f$ is affine and the restriction $A\to\mathcal O_X(W_f)$ is a localization at $f$, so $\mathcal O_X(W_f)=A_f$; and by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-affine-section-base-change] $\mathcal F(W_f)\cong M\otimes_AA_f\cong M_f$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] as $A_f$-modules, $m|_{W_f}\leftrightarrow m/1$ ($M\otimes_AA_f\to M_f$, $m\otimes(r/f^e)\mapsto rm/f^e$, is the standard isomorphism). An isomorphism of $A_f$-modules preserves annihilators, so Step 2 for $W_f$ gives $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(W_f)=\operatorname{Ann}_{A_f}(M_f)$, and [lem-weil-pbc-annihilator-localization-finite] gives $\operatorname{Ann}_{A_f}(M_f)=\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)A_f$, the ideal generated by the image of $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)=\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(W)$ (Step 2) under the restriction $A\to A_f$. This is the 'algebra fact' to which Stacks reduces the lemma.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 05JU: 'This comes down to the following algebra fact: If A is a ring, f in A, and M is a finite A-module, then Ann_A(M)_f = Ann_{A_f}(M_f). We omit the proof.' (Algebra, Lemma 07T8)

proof.text: *Step 4 (the closed subscheme; clause (2)).* By Steps 2 and 3 the ideals $I_W=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_X(W)}(\mathcal F(W))=\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(W)$, $W$ affine open, satisfy the hypothesis of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-ideals-closed-subscheme](1). It gives a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] has $\mathcal I(W)=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_X(W)}(\mathcal F(W))$ for every affine open $W$, such that for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $i^{-1}(U)\to U$ is isomorphic over $U$ to $\operatorname{Spec}(A/\operatorname{Ann}_A(\mathcal F(U)))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ (the second half of (2)), and with $i(Z)\cap U$ corresponding to $V(\operatorname{Ann}_A(\mathcal F(U)))$.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 05JU ('it suffices to prove that the given rule produces a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, see Lemma 01QQ') and Lemma 01QQ (morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion-bijection-ideals)

proof.text: *Step 5 ($\mathcal I=\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$; clause (1) and the first half of (2)).* $\mathcal I$ and $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ (Step 1) are subsheaves of $\mathcal O_X$ which, by Steps 2 and 4, have the same sections on every affine open. For any open $V$ and $a\in\mathcal O_X(V)$, the affine opens $W\subseteq V$ cover $V$ [def-pc-scheme], and since both are sheaves (Step 1; $\mathcal I$ is the kernel of a map of sheaves), $a$ lies in either one iff all $a|_W$ do; so $\mathcal I(V)=\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(V)$. Hence $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ is the ideal sheaf of the closed immersion $i$, so it is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)=\operatorname{Ann}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}(\mathcal F(U))$ on affine opens is Step 2. This proves (1) and that the ideal sheaf of $i$ is $\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$ in (2).

*Step 6 (clause (3): $i(Z)=\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$).* Let $U$ be an affine open, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $M=\mathcal F(U)$, identified with $\operatorname{Spec}A$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. By Step 4, $i(Z)\cap U$ is the set of $x\in U$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_A(M)\subseteq\mathfrak p_x$; by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed], $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\cap U$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2) is the same set. The affine opens cover $X$ [def-pc-scheme], so $i(Z)=\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 05JU (4) and its proof ('We have Supp = Z by Algebra, Lemma 00L2 (algebra-lemma-support-closed)')

proof.text: *Step 7 (clauses (4) and (5)).* (4): for $a\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(V)$ and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, take the open $V\subseteq V$ in the definition: $as=a|_Vs=0$. (5): let $\mathcal I'$ be the ideal sheaf of a closed immersion $i':Z'\to X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] with $\mathcal I'\mathcal F=0$, i.e. $bs=0$ for every open $V$, $b\in\mathcal I'(V)$, $s\in\mathcal F(V)$. Let $a\in\mathcal I'(U)$; for $V\subseteq U$ open, $a|_V\in\mathcal I'(V)$ ($\mathcal I'$ is a subsheaf), so $a|_Vs=0$ for all $s\in\mathcal F(V)$; thus $a\in\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)(U)$ and $\mathcal I'\subseteq\operatorname{Ann}(\mathcal F)$. (This is the minimality of $Z$ in Stacks 05JU, stated in terms of ideals: $Z'$ with $\mathcal I'\mathcal F=0$ contains $Z$.)

lean.statement: theorem schemeTheoreticSupport (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] : ∃ (I : X.IdealSheafData), (∀ (U : X.affineOpens), I.ideal U = Module.annihilator (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U.1)) (F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U.1))) ∧ IsClosedImmersion I.subschemeι ∧ I.subschemeι.ker = I ∧ (∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)), a ∈ RingHom.ker (I.subschemeι.app U).hom ↔ ∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U) (s : F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)), X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a • s = 0) ∧ (∀ (U : X.affineOpens), IsPullback (I.subschemeCover.f U) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U)))) I.subschemeι U.2.fromSpec) ∧ Set.range I.subschemeι = {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} ∧ (∀ (V : X.Opens) (a : RingHom.ker (I.subschemeι.app V).hom) (s : F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)), a • s = 0) ∧ (∀ (Z' : Scheme.{u}) (i' : Z' ⟶ X), IsClosedImmersion i' → (∀ (V : X.Opens) (a : RingHom.ker (i'.app V).hom) (s : F.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V)), a • s = 0) → ∀ (U : X.Opens), RingHom.ker (i'.app U).hom ≤ RingHom.ker (I.subschemeι.app U).hom)
